theme.title: Theme: {{mode}} — click to force light/dark (Auto → Light → Dark)

app.apoWarning: ⚠ Equalizer APO isn't installed on this device, so applying an EQ here has no effect. Enable it for this device with Equalizer APO's <0>Configurator</0> (DeviceSelector.exe), then reboot.

fit.label: Fit
fit.hint: Personal correction on top of the target — pads, seal, your own ears.

content.label: Content
content.hint: Adjustments for what you're playing — dialogue lift, a bright master.

tone.label: Tone
tone.hint: Your permanent taste. The fixed Bass / Treble / Air macros live here.

autoeq.label: AutoEq
autoeq.hint: AutoEq's automatic parametric fit toward the target — read-only, shown for the curious. Your Fit / Content / Tone stages add on top.

correction.title: Correction
correction.clipping: ⚠ Emergency clipping protection active instead of the loudness match — extreme peak.
correction.addHeadroomTitle: Lower the base pre-gain so the loudness match fits instead of the clipping ceiling

chart.impulseCaption: Impulse-response decay of the applied filter chain (dB envelope) — window auto-set to the decay.
chart.nodeEdit: Drag to edit · wheel for Q · double-click to remove
chart.nodeMacro: Macro band — drag to edit · wheel for Q (not removable)

bands.title: Filter bands
bands.addTitle: Add a band in the widest gap (or double-click the chart to place one)
bands.dryNotice: Dry is the fixed reference — pick Slot A or B to edit filter bands.
bands.hint: Drag a value to scrub, click to type, ↑/↓ to fine-tune · double-click the chart to add a band (or a node to remove it) · changes apply live.
bands.emptyHint: This stage has no bands yet — press ＋ or double-click the chart to add one.
bands.autoeqReadonly: Read-only — these bands come straight from AutoEq's fit. Change the target or your own stages to reshape the sound.
bands.fixedTitle: {{macro}} macro — always available, can't be removed
bands.scrubTitle: {{label}} — drag to scrub, click to type, ↑/↓ to step ({{min}}…{{max}})

compare.title: Compare
compare.shortcuts: A / S / D switch slots, W toggles the loudness mode — even without looking at the screen.
compare.finalWarning: ⚠ Final volume: each slot plays at its own max volume, so A/B/Dry aren't loudness-matched — a louder slot can just sound "better". Press <0>W</0> for Comparison to A/B fairly.

loudness.title: Loudness
loudness.comparisonDesc: Every curve ends up equally loud, so A/B comparisons judge timbre, not level.
loudness.finalDesc: Maximum clipping-free volume — base pre-gain and loudness match are disabled.
loudness.confirmToggle: Confirm before switching to Final volume

presets.title: Presets & filters
presets.saveTitle: Save the current setup or tone
presets.fullPresetDisabledTitle: Pick a headphone to save a full preset
presets.presetHint: Saves the measurement, target curve and all filter stages — loading replaces the whole setup.
presets.templateHint: Saves the current {{stage}} stage's bands — loading drops them into {{stage}}, keeping measurement & target.
presets.updatePresetDisabledTitle: Pick a headphone to overwrite this preset
presets.emptyPresets: Pick a headphone + target, then 💾 Save a full preset to recall the whole setup.

meter.levelTitle: Output level (dBFS): phosphor fill, amber peak, neutral RMS

banner.terminal: Safety shutdown: the audio DSP couldn't be recovered, so EQ is muted.
banner.recovering: Recovering the audio DSP… (safe state active, EQ muted)
banner.safeState: A safety shutdown from a previous session is still active (EQ muted). Apply a correction to restore it.
banner.externallyModified: cageq.txt was changed outside CAGEq since the last run — the shown state may not match what's applied.

dialog.finalTitle: Switching to <0>Final volume</0> raises the volume by <1>+{{jump}} dB</1> (ramped in at 6 dB/s). Continue?
dialog.dontAskAgain: Don't ask again (re-enable in the Loudness panel)
dialog.overwritePreset: A preset named “{{name}}” already exists. Overwrite it?
dialog.overwriteTemplate: A {{stage}} template named “{{name}}” already exists. Overwrite it?
dialog.updatePreset: Overwrite the preset “{{name}}” with the current headphone, target and all stages?
dialog.updateTemplate: Overwrite the {{stage}} template “{{name}}” with the current {{stage}} bands?
dialog.deletePreset: Delete the preset “{{name}}”? This can't be undone.
dialog.deleteTemplate: Delete the filter template “{{name}}”? This can't be undone.

errors.pickHeadphone: Pick a headphone model and measurement first.
errors.slotEmpty: Slot {{from}} is empty — apply something to it first.
